title: THATS NOT MY FRIEND
description: The modpack focuses on making players fear everything. It is intended for multiplayer but is just as effective when played alone. The modpack uses imposters to mimic you and your friends, along with other mods that create random scares for the players.
body: Players are dropped into a permanant winter with nothing to start with. The mod pack is designed to be played with 2 or more players but works just as well with only one. several creatures have been added to the mod pack to scare, haunt, kill, and stalk the player aswell as mimic their friends or them. Most creatures spawn in the caves but some still spawn on the surface to keep the players on edge.
